text:
nina (People Ops): Quick update: we're opening a 30-day Leave Donation & Conversion window starting 2026-07-01. Two parts: 1) Donate up to 5 unused PTO days to a colleague facing long-term caregiving or medical leave. 2) One-time conversion: employees affected by visa/passport delays can convert up to 3 unused PTO days into paid Emergency Travel Leave. Details below and link to policy. :handshake:

omar (People Ops): Eligibility: regular employees (FT & part-time 20+ hrs/wk). Donated days go to a central pool; managers and People Ops approve distributions case-by-case. Contractors not eligible to donate or receive.

syl (Finance): Note: donations are non-taxable transfers in most regions; conversions and payouts may have tax implications. Finance will include a note on the reimbursement/advice page.

kevin (Eng): How do people request to receive donated days?

nina (People Ops): Employees can submit a confidential request form (link in doc) that goes to People Ops and the recipient's manager. We try to keep medical details private; a short attestation is enough.

omar (People Ops): Timeline: donations open 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-30. People Ops will run distributions the week after the window closes. Conversion requests for visa/travel delays must include evidence of processing/official delay.

kevin (Eng): If I donate, does it affect my accruals or carryover?

syl (Finance): Donated days reduce your available balance but do NOT change your accrual rate. Donors keep normal carryover rules for remaining PTO.

hr-bot: Policy doc published: https://docs.redwood.company/people-ops/leave-donation-conversion-window 12026-07-01 v1.0

nina (People Ops): We're trying to make this low-friction and compassionate. Questions or edge cases, DM People Ops or post in #help-people-ops. Thanks! :seedling:
